pages.title: Capybara
pages.text: The capybara ($(o)Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris$()) is the largest living rodent, found in the wetlands and riverbanks of South America.$(br2)It lives in groups, grazing on grasses and water plants, and dives to escape jaguars and other predators.$(br2)Capybaras are famously calm, and birds often perch on their backs to pick off insects.
